recorded_asymmetry_not_resolved: In a Gated-DeltaNet layer the recurrent state accumulates across sequence positions, so applying the frozen all-position edit alters a state trajectory with no exact counterpart in softmax attention. This changes the CHARACTER of the intervention relative to Qwen3/Gemma even though the causal path is analogous. It is recorded as a cross-architecture interpretive limitation, not resolved, and must be disclosed in any comparison.
why_defensible: Both layers are standard pre-norm residual decoder blocks: h = h + mixer(LN1(h)); h = h + mlp(LN2(h)).
The MLP output is added to the residual stream, exactly as in Qwen3-8B and Gemma-2-9B.

Layers 19-31 read that residual stream. Subsequent Gated-DeltaNet layers derive their recurrent state FROM the residual via in_proj(input_layernorm(h)), so an edit at layer 18 propagates into their state rather than bypassing it.
The intervention therefore enters downstream computation through the same causal path as in the prior two models; it is not a transient representation.
